title: Installer campaigns
summary: Local state checks follow the Apply journey that creates their subject; cold-start-hosted checks token existence, directory mode 700 and token modes 600 before mission cleanup, with separate diagnostics. Review captures the full pending-write list and already-saved token reuse before backing out. Browser approval requires a visible control and same-tab confirmation or navigation. Machine-only late-harness discovery checks unattended permissions; project hook trust and received context require exploration proof. Hosted recovery retains fail-fast backup assertions and post-exit capture readiness; source correctness does not establish live campaign acceptance. The source plan moves obstacle-prone cold-start-hosted, second-machine-join, review-frame, connect-wait and welcome-frame to exploratory missions with the original expected texts and end states as prose checks. Retire the hosted-connect campaign recipe in favor of its separate mission. Stable Machine state, install-health, issue-sync, uninstall, stale-reinstall, outside-project, prepare and Command checks stay deterministic. Every workaround needs evidence and must preserve the tested boundary. Installer exploration on an as-is host builds its mature-project archetype during the walk by cloning public commit history and adding existing work before installing Yoke. The walker opens interactive sessions on the desktop; personal approval is the human gate. No baseline or pre-existing project fixture is required.
